summary: u7-f: the ui-family lane's .mjs runtime face and its reviewed descriptor packages/tools/families/ui.mjs. The seam re-hashes the descriptor against the manifest at mount and the generated index statically imports it, so the descriptor and every lane file the index reaches sit in the mirror at the same relative layout (relative edges ../../../domain/…, ../../fs-family/…, sibling ./… resolve identically from src and mirror because the mirror sits at dist/packages/…).
